description: Cancels an unfinished, or checked but not yet installed, modpack upload and discards the file. An installed modpack is not affected; remove it with deleteModpack.

key.description: key returned by the start call; pass it unchanged.

uploadId.description: uploadId returned by the start call for this file.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

name: abortModpackUpload
title: Cancel a modpack upload
